messages:
drew: quick heads-up: noticed sampleapp staging emitting unredacted request ids after latest SDK beta. example line:

    INFO 2026-03-21T09:12:01Z handler served user=carol req_id=4f3e2d1c-... status=200

nina: yikes. env and SDK version?

drew: node sampleapp, SDK=1.4.1-beta, REDACT_REQIDS=true, OTEL_AUTO_INSTRUMENT=1, LOG_LEVEL=info

harpreet: sounds like the same class of ordering bug we've seen: otel exporter merging attributes into the record after our redactor runs. plus our redactor currently only scans the message string and some specific keys (request_id, x-request-id) not abbreviated keys like `req_id`.

drew: repro steps I used:
1) checkout sampleapp@main + sdk v1.4.1-beta
2) env as above
3) bombard /api/echo 300x
4) tail logs/staging.log | rg "req_id="

nina: interesting that WARN hides them because those are info-level lines. makes it harder to detect in production.

harpreet: short term: add `req_id` to redaction key list and run a tiny e2e to simulate batched flush merging attributes late. long term we should run structured redaction on the log record object (pre-serialization) and ensure it's the last sync hook.

drew: I threw together a quick patch that: (A) extends key list to include `req_id`/`requestid`/`x_req_id`, (B) attaches a sync redaction step after the otel merger. test passes locally. will open PR momentarily.

ci-bot: build #4789 queued for drew/reqid-ordering-fix :gear:

nina: please add a tiny test that runs on node18+node20; we saw behavioral differences across runtime due to how the batcher schedules nextTick timers.

drew: good call, adding matrix test. also adding a blurb to sampleapp/README about OTEL_AUTO_INSTRUMENT ordering so folks know how to debug.

harpreet: also add a short comment in the SDK changelog: "If you rely on REDACT_REQIDS and auto-instrumentation, ensure SDK >= 1.4.1-beta+redact-ordering" so users upgrading see the fix.

drew: PR open, pinging @harpreet for review. ci started.

ci-bot: test suite running (unit + e2e).

nina: will validate staging once CI green. thanks for quick turnaround.

drew: leaving this thread until staging validation completes. last note 2165024050
